overview:
**Fire danger remains Low across the Montrose (High Elevation) area today, driven by cool temperatures, light fuels activity, and no meaningful dryness signal.**
- The 7-day outlook holds steady at Low through December 1, with ERC easing slightly from 37% to 33% as 1000-hr fuels stay near 20%.
- A cold, dry pattern dominates: highs sit in the 30s-40s with a windier spell Saturday (gusts to 20 mph from the NE) before calming into Thanksgiving week.
- None of the 7 local watchout thresholds are triggered, and no Red Flag Warning is in effect for the area.
- BLM's Gunnison Field Office lifted its Stage 1 fire restrictions in September, with only standard year-round wildfire prevention rules remaining in effect; Montrose County likewise shows no active stage restrictions.
- No wildfires are reported burning in or near the 13-county Montrose area; national preparedness remains at Level 1, Rocky Mountain Area at PL 2, with no nearby incidents listed.
